luna_triage.reason: Study 2 tests whether supervisor feedback improves therapists’ guided-compliance integrity, the staff-skill maintenance finding of Parsons and Reid. The supplied shipped row is Shuler and Carroll, a distinct study. Though Study 2 is called an extension of Shuler and Carroll, it empirically retests the feedback-to-staff-skills result.
